profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: I am passionate about solving problems and simplifying processes through automation. I have a strong interest in continuous integration and delivery. My focus has been on building my skillset around scripting, data analysis/visualization, and cloud services. Aside from work, I enjoy spending time with my family, playing billiards and the guitar. I also love any opportunity to spend time outdoors whether it's hiking or playing tennis or hitting the ski slopes in the winter.

positions.title: Software Release Engineer
positions.description:
· Managing software releases for multiple platforms and standardizing processes across the software development teams.
· Consolidating steps to build software packages and reducing inefficiencies stemming from manual procedures.
· Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration systems for firmware builds and testing.
· Coordinating developer changes to coincide with planned software releases.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
· Develop software application on handheld devices to address the test and measurement needs of wireless service providers and technicians in maintaining wireless equipment and RF systems.
· Test and troubleshoot the firmware of existing handheld devices.
· Work closely with the development team to communicate customer requirements and designs by conducting peer reviews and design walk-through.
· Analyze use cases and create automated tests that run on our test and build system.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
· Support production line related software and hardware issues.
           · Write routines to exercise/test products to maintain reliability and quality.
           · Work with design and firmware engineers on new products from pilot phase to production.
           · Communicate with production line technicians about test procedures.
           · Optimize production flow and analyze historical data to eliminate redundant tests.

        Software Development:
        Database Editor ­ Designed an application to interact with relational database
           · Tool for test engineers to write test specifications for new/current products.
           · Simplifies insertions/updates to relational database through SQL/DDL statements.
           · Worked with .NET framework to create user interface for uploading test specifications.

        Test Executive ­ Designed a platform for testing products on the production line
           · Created multi-threaded application in Visual Basic .NET.
           · Used the Plug-in design pattern to permit dynamic addition of forms and utilities.
           · Utilized named pipes of Windows Communication Foundation to pass application data to
               dynamic linked libraries that contain test routines for exercising/calibrating products.
           · Implemented backup feature to allow continued testing if network gets disconnected.

        Codeloader ­ Consolidated firmware loading process with Python scripts
           · Centralized procedures to load FPGAs, PLDs and Flash memory on motherboard.
           · Eliminated errors due to manual code loading process.
           · Improved traceability of the firmware code being installed on each motherboard.
           · Automated control of third-party applications with Python library (pyWinAuto).

positions.title: Software Requirements Analyst
positions.description:
Software Development:
           · Created a PERL script to parse and convert software requirements specification written in
              plain English into a format recognizable as input to an in-house program.
           · Worked on a VBA application to enhance requirements analysis.
